items.prompt_body: OUTPUT: ONE tall image. FIVE complete JACKAL TAPES promo banners stacked top to bottom (Telegram scroll filmstrip). Each panel: wide landscape banner (~16:9) with full UI chrome. Overall composite: 9:16 portrait strip. NOT 2×2 grid. Panel order: PANEL-1 THE INTERVIEW, PANEL-2 BREAK THE MAN, PANEL-3 WAR IS HOME, PANEL-4 MIKE'S BAR, PANEL-5 THE DISPLAY. LAYOUT LOCK per panel: distressed white AOF + red JACKAL TAPES, panel subtitle, compact QR with Telegram logo, red pill columns, t.me/aofmainhub link bar, footer icons. STYLE: war-noir Betacam/VHS grain, mercenary Africa, voyeuristic documentary dread, no IP likeness, no gore. Panel-1: interview silhouettes REC 00:14:33. Panel-2: split silhouette + cracked mirror, quote THE HARDER YOU BEAT A MAN THE TALLER HE STANDS. Panel-3: night convoy cassette player puppet wires. Panel-4: Mike's Bar smoke tape exchange. Panel-5: mud tableau mask mirror VHS static IF YOU LOSE YOURSELF IN THE DISPLAY. Same UI every panel, vary backgrounds only. AVOID: 2x2 grid, bleeding panels, misspelled text, gore.
